narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in FY2026 to date. Obligations are up 124.5% year over year, driven by two awards with an average award size of $1.4B. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $1.1B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, and $1.3B in FY25, before the current-year total of $2.9B. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Northrop Grumman Systems with $2.9B in obligations in FY2026 to date. Engineering Services recorded $1.2M in FY2026 to date. The current-year totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date results rather than full-year totals. Two large awards account for most of the obligated dollars this year, which raises the average award size and concentrates spending in a small number of transactions. This profile matters for contractors and partners who compete in aerospace and missile systems because a small number of high-value awards can quickly change annual obligations and market rankings.
